who.value: seller whose auction ended below reserve

job.value: Choose a price and offer the card to everyone who bid

arrivedFrom.value: the Updates notification about the unmet reserve

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Your reserve price for "Mew 030/028" wasn't met — Choose your price and offer it to everyone who bid' states exactly what to do.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Offer to bidders >' link with the '2d 18h left' timer is the clearest action on the card.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Offer to bidders' says what will happen.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Reserve price' is the seller's own setting, so they know the term.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Deciding whether to make an offer is something the seller can do now.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the headline, one line and a timer; offer details come on the next step.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The notification sits in Updates right when the auction closed, which is when it's relevant.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Bold title and one short line; the seller can tap without reading more.
